name: Next Wiki Agent Memory
description: Bridges OpenClaw session lifecycle to the next-wiki generic Agent Memory service. Hook-only/non-capability: does not claim the OpenClaw memory slot and coexists with any local memory provider.

wikiApiBaseUrl.description: Deployment API root ending in /api/v1. HTTPS required outside local development.

credential.description: Secret reference for one Agent memory connection credential. Never logged or returned in diagnostics.
